arguments.summary: Decision: develop differentiated, non-ranked 21/63-session research drafts for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, conditioned on company fundamentals, dated QQQ look-through, fixed benchmark technical context, and macro/policy transmission. Grouped work has been dispatched to Company, Macro, Technical and Geopolitics. Commodities is omitted because the seeded catalog does not identify a dedicated commodity input; MU cycle considerations are within Company/Geopolitics scope.

claims.text: Company operating evidence, dated ETF holdings, macro/policy channels, and market-relative technical context are complementary inputs for differentiated short-horizon research; none should be treated as sufficient alone.

gaps.description: No completed specialist evidence is yet available. Instrument assessments, company valuation assumptions, current policy/macro readings, earnings-event timing, and technical measures remain unverified pending assigned work.
The seeded catalog does not identify a dedicated commodity dataset or a demonstrated material commodity-price transmission channel.

assumptions: SPY, XLK, and XLC are used only as declared comparison context, not as portfolio proxies.
QQQ look-through will be constrained to the dated sponsor profile and holdings evidence reviewed by the Company specialist.
The work will not force a ranking, actionable quote, or calibrated forecast.
arguments.counter_thesis: Unobserved earnings, policy, or macro events may dominate 21/63-session outcomes, leaving filed fundamentals and historical price context insufficient to resolve an assessment.

review_conditions.description: Review the combined specialist record before any instrument-level assessment because material factual inputs remain pending.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Potential shared sensitivity to growth expectations, discount rates, risk appetite, and policy shocks is being tested; QQQ overlap remains subject to dated-holdings review.
shared_exposures.qualification: Research hypothesis only, not a measured exposure or holdings-weight assertion.
